concerns.text: The plan cites ingestion of cloud‑screened Landsat thermal rasters via the NASA EarthData API but provides **no verified URL or open-access dataset**. FR‑002 requires a verified source; the lack of a reachable, open dataset means the pipeline will abort if the download fails, preventing the analysis from completing. Replace the unverified NASA/EarthData download with a publicly reachable, pre‑processed Landsat LST mosaic (e.g., a HuggingFace or AWS Open Data URL) or otherwise provide a verified citation.
